import random,json
r=random.Random(1922)
N=120000
m={k:0 for k in ['unsafe_naive','accept_naive','accept_typed','accept_universal','escalate_typed','escalate_universal','harmless_universal']}
for _ in range(N):
 eff=r.choices(['read','reversible','irreversible'],[.4,.35,.25])[0]
 has_hard=r.random()<.55; has_soft=r.random()<.60; amb=r.random()<.14
 ambcrit=amb and r.random() < (.75 if eff=='irreversible' else .35)
 authreq=eff=='irreversible'; auth=(not authreq) or r.random()<.93
 hardmis=has_hard and r.random() < (.11 if amb else .025)
 overhard=has_soft and r.random()<.08
 auth_assumed=authreq and (not auth) and r.random()<.70
 na=not overhard; nu=na and (hardmis or auth_assumed)
 te=ambcrit or (authreq and not auth); ta=not te
 ue=amb or has_soft or (authreq and not auth); ua=not ue
 trueproblem=ambcrit or (authreq and not auth)
 m['unsafe_naive']+=nu; m['accept_naive']+=na; m['accept_typed']+=ta; m['accept_universal']+=ua; m['escalate_typed']+=te; m['escalate_universal']+=ue; m['harmless_universal']+=(ue and not trueproblem)
for k in m:m[k]/=N
# Intent-adequacy oracle fault model
r=random.Random(2922); N2=120000; cov=.90
fault=struct=sem=combined=0
for _ in range(N2):
 if r.random()>=.12: continue
 fault+=1; kind=r.choices(['syntax','stale','semantic'],[.3,.2,.5])[0]
 s=kind in ('syntax','stale'); t=(kind=='semantic' and r.random()<cov)
 struct+=s; sem+=(kind=='semantic'); combined+=(s or t)
o={'faults':fault,'struct_detection_given_fault':struct/fault,'semantic_struct_detection':0.0,'combined_detection_given_fault':combined/fault,'semantic_test_coverage':cov}
print(json.dumps({'intent_policy':m,'intent_adequacy':o}))
